role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
promise: Restore the NHS England standard that 92% of patients wait no more than 18 weeks from referral to elective treatment by March 2029
description: The December 2024 Plan for Change pledged to restore England's elective-treatment waiting-time standard. DHSC's annual report specifies March 2029 as the target date.
evidence: Official sources establish scope and timeline; the 2029 outcome remains pending.
sources: UK PMO: Plan for Change announcement

promise: Express a three-year aspiration for around 80% of Syrians in Germany to return, described as al-Sharaa's wish rather than a guaranteed quota
description: At the March 30, 2026 joint appearance, Merz discussed large-scale returns over three years. This was an aspiration, not evidence that returns had occurred.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the retrieved reporting concerns the aspiration and its contested attribution, not a measured return outcome.
